turns.learner: Hello teacher. I want to practise joining sentences, please.
turns.tutor:
Hello! Great, let's practise. We can join two short sentences with and, but or because. Example: I like tea and I like milk.

Try this one with "and": "I have a cat. I have a dog." How can you join them?

turns.learner: I have a cat. And I have a dog.
turns.tutor:
Good, you use "and" correctly! But look: you put a full stop before "and". Then "And I have a dog" is not a full sentence. We join with "and" in the same sentence, with no full stop.

Try again: "I have a cat and I have a dog." Now try the "but" exercise: "The bus is cheap. It is slow."

turns.learner: Ok. I have a cat and I have a dog. The bus is cheap. But it is slow.
turns.tutor:
Yes! "I have a cat and I have a dog." is correct. Well done.

But with "but" you did the same thing: "The bus is cheap. But it is slow." The full stop is before "but". Join them in one sentence: "The bus is cheap but it is slow."

Can you write it again with no full stop? Then try "I am happy. It is my birthday." with "because".

turns.learner: The bus is cheap but it is slow. I am happy. Because it is my birthday.
turns.tutor:
Great! "The bus is cheap but it is slow." is correct.

For "because", look again: "I am happy. Because it is my birthday." "Because it is my birthday" cannot stand alone. It gives the reason, so it must stay in the same sentence.

Try: "I am happy because it is my birthday." Can you say why we do not use a full stop before because?

turns.learner: Maybe because the reason is part of the first sentence? I am not sure. Can I try: I was late because. The bus was slow?
turns.tutor:
Yes, you are right! The reason is part of the first sentence. That is a good idea.

Now your try: "I was late because. The bus was slow." Here the full stop comes after "because", so the reason is cut off. Put the reason straight after "because": "I was late because the bus was slow."

Please write that sentence. Then make one new sentence with "because" yourself.

turns.learner: I was late because the bus was slow. I like coffee because it is hot.
turns.tutor:
Excellent! Both sentences are correct, and there is no full stop before "because". Well done!

Quick check: please make one sentence with "and" and one with "but" about your day. Remember, keep the linking word in the same sentence.
